entries.note: The waybill opened and the freight taken into the origin depot: the first row in the firm's hands.
Sorted out of the origin depot onto its line.
Loaded onto a line truck that left the depot the row names.
On the road, with the day and month the firm expects the freight at the destination.
Arrived at the branch that delivers it, in the city the row names.
Out for delivery from that branch.
The pickup or delivery done and signed for; the reader drops the signer the row names.
A short haul to the branch named, as the firm's row template in the portal's reply words it.
Loaded onto a line truck that left, with the count of pieces; the reader drops the plate the template adds.
Arrived at the branch the row names and unloaded.
A delivery round with the count of pieces; the reader drops the plate the template adds.
Passed on to the branch or partner named for the rest of the way; the reader drops the plate the template adds.
The return receipt signed: paperwork about the waybill, so the row keeps the stage of the one before it.
The signed return receipt sent back to the origin: paperwork, so the row keeps the stage of the one before it.
The origin received the signed return receipt: paperwork, so the row keeps the stage of the one before it.
The signed return receipt handed back to the shipper: paperwork, so the row keeps the stage of the one before it.
